case_number: 2025 INSC 315; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 [Arising out of SLP (Criminal) No. 4774 of 2024]

parties.respondent: M/S Morgan Securities And Credits Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Non-executive director liability under NI Act; specific allegations required for vicarious liability under s.141; mere designation insufficient without direct involvement; reliance on attendance records inadequate; board approval non-participation; quashing denied improperly by High Court; dismissal of SLPs unjustified; standard: strict construction of penal vicarious liability; pre-trial determination possible for non-involvement; case remanded with direction to quash.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings quashed against non-executive directors in absence of specific allegations of active role.
